old_problem: The active review retained a decision for RDMA endpoint/profile/threshold values that can be mandatory project configuration. Its command discussion also needed to exclude Ethernet iperf because that would not exercise RDMA Write verbs, memory registration and HCA queues.
disposition_reason: The linux-rdma perftest documentation defines ib_write_bw as an RDMA Write bandwidth benchmark, requires matching server/client mode options, supports fixed duration with `-D`, and warns that matching versions and an active InfiniBand subnet manager are required. ED-03 permits exact topology/profile as configuration, ED-05 separates InfiniBand from Ethernet, ED-14 preserves all eight hours, and ED-15 requires signed numeric thresholds before PASS. No new engineering decision is needed to define the review-layer case.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row400 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2992 and its unique source identity.
Applied upstream linux-rdma perftest semantics for ib_write_bw server/client roles, matching mode options, HCA/port/GID controls and fixed-duration execution.
Kept RDMA Write verbs distinct from Ethernet throughput; iperf and raw Ethernet tools are not accepted substitutes.
Retained the full 28,800-second duration and required periodic health correlation; a smoke run or final-only average cannot pass.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row401 and verified its manifest identity; no RDMA traffic, package installation or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Eight-hour BlueField InfiniBand RDMA Write bandwidth and health soak
test_case.purpose: Exercise the exact isolated BlueField InfiniBand path with a pinned ib_write_bw RDMA Write workload for eight continuous hours and prove sustained bandwidth, fabric, HCA and system health against the approved specification.
required_package: Pinned checksum-verified matching linux-rdma perftest/ib_write_bw and compatible rdma-core versions on both endpoints
Exact HCA/BDF/device/port/GUID/GID/P_Key/peer/switch-fabric map and active subnet-manager proof
Approved server/client roles, connection type, message size, QP count, queue depths, direction, duration, margins and reporting mode
Numeric sustained/final bandwidth, variance, retry/error/port-counter, thermal and system-log thresholds
Isolated fabric window, independent management, monitoring/abort limits, process cleanup and recovery plan
test_case.test_command: After proving matching perftest versions, active InfiniBand fabric and immutable endpoint map, capture full ibstat/sysfs link/rate, HCA/port counters and system/thermal baseline. Start the approved ib_write_bw server bound to the signed HCA/port/GID and launch the peer client with identical mode options and `--duration 28800`; preserve stdout/stderr and periodic bandwidth data using the approved reporting strategy. Concurrently sample port/HCA/retry/error and system/BMC/thermal telemetry for all eight hours, enforce signed abort limits, stop both processes and collect final health.
test_case.expected_result: The exact RDMA Write session runs for the complete 28,800 seconds on the signed InfiniBand HCA/port/GID and produces complete periodic/final bandwidth evidence. All applicable results meet approved numeric thresholds, link rate/state and subnet remain healthy, no disallowed HCA/port/retry/system/thermal event occurs, and endpoints/fabric remain workable after cleanup.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires matching pinned artifacts and mode options, immutable InfiniBand identities, full eight-hour time coverage, signed numeric bandwidth/variance/error thresholds, synchronized HCA/fabric/system telemetry and clean post-health. Without project thresholds the result is NOT EVALUATED, never PASS; iperf, Ethernet counters, a short run or final-only average cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Use only the isolated non-management InfiniBand path and approved peer; never saturate shared production fabric
Verify HCA, port, GID/P_Key, link layer, subnet manager and matching perftest versions before launch
Approve identical server/client message/QP/depth/direction parameters and resource footprint
Preserve full port/HCA/system logs and monitor live retry/error/link/thermal limits without clearing history
Abort on access loss, link-state/rate change, retry/error threshold, thermal limit, peer failure or fabric impact; clean up once and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Perftest/rdma-core versions and checksums plus exact server/client commands
Complete 28,800-second ib_write_bw stdout/stderr and periodic/final bandwidth evidence
Synchronized InfiniBand state/rate, port/HCA retry/error counters and peer telemetry
System/BMC/thermal/log trace and numeric project-threshold evaluation
Process cleanup, post-health comparison and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On bandwidth, link, HCA, thermal, access or peer failure, terminate only the mapped ib_write_bw processes, verify subnet manager and both endpoint port states, restore any temporary binding/configuration, preserve partial evidence and diagnose before any separately authorized rerun. Do not shorten or automatically retry the soak.
